title: Link App Configuration Registry
description: Enumerates all required application configuration keys needed to run the system in any deployed environment.

global.description: Configurations shared across most or all services.

description.description: A brief explanation of what the setting does and why it is required.

required.description: Whether the setting is strictly required for the service to start/function correctly.

global.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka bootstrap servers for event messaging.
The type of database provider to use (e.g., SqlServer, MongoDB).
The connection string for the primary service database.
The OIDC authority URL used for validating bearer tokens.
The authority URL used by the LinkTokenService for internal token generation and validation.
The secret key used for signing internal tokens. Must be kept secure.
Boolean flag to enable or disable OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics.
The endpoint URI for the Grafana Loki log aggregator.
The connection string for the Redis cache (e.g., 'localhost:6379,password=...').
The connection string for the internal Azure Blob Storage (or Azurite).
The name of the blob container used for internal storage.
The base URL for the Tenant Service.
The base URL for the Account Service.
The base URL for the Report Service.
The base URL for the Measure Service.
The base URL for the Census Service.
The base URL for the Data Acquisition Service.
The base URL for the Normalization Service.
The base URL for the Validation Service.
The base URL for the Submission Service.
The base URL for the Terminology Service.
The base URL for the Audit Service.
The base URL for the Query Dispatch Service.
The base URL for the Notification Service.
The base URL for the Report Service (used by Java services).
Boolean flag to enable or disable secret management.
The type of secret manager to use (e.g., AzureKeyVault).
The URI for the secret manager.
List of ISO 8601 durations defining the retry intervals for Kafka consumers.
Boolean flag to disable the retry consumer for Kafka events.
Boolean flag to disable the Kafka consumer entirely for the service.

Account.description: Boolean flag to enable automatic activation of new users.

AdminBFF.description: The OAuth2 client ID for the Admin BFF.
The OAuth2 client secret for the Admin BFF.
The OAuth2 user information endpoint URL.
The backend address for each service routed through the BFF (e.g., AccountService, AuditService, etc.).
Boolean flag to enable monitoring of backend service health.

Audit.description: The client ID for the Kafka connection.

AutomationUI.description: The base URL for the external FHIR server used for testing.
The base URL for the internal FHIR server used for testing.
The MongoDB connection string for automation data.
The MongoDB database name for automation data.

DataAcquisition.description: The cron expression defining how often data acquisition jobs should run.
The expiration time in minutes for distributed locks.

DataAcquisitionWorker.description: The maximum number of concurrent data acquisition tasks.
The capacity of the internal work channel for acquisition tasks.

Census.description: Comma-separated list of FHIR Observation codes used to identify census events.

MeasureEval.description: Kafka bootstrap servers for the measure evaluation service.
The OIDC authority URL for token validation.
Fully qualified class name of the reportability predicate to use.
Boolean flag to enable CQL debugging.

Notification.description: The SMTP server hostname for sending notifications.

QueryDispatch.description: The prefix for Quartz job collections in the database.

Report.description: Boolean flag to enable detailed logging of database queries.

Submission.description: The local or network path where submission files are stored.
The number of patient bundles to process in a single batch.
The connection string for the external Azure Blob Storage (where submissions are stored).
The name of the blob container used for external storage.

Tenant.description: Boolean flag to restrict facility IDs to numeric values only.

Terminology.description: The path to the terminology data files.

Validation.description: The SQL Server database connection URL for the validation service.
Kafka bootstrap servers for the validation service.
The Redis host for the validation service.
The Redis port for the validation service.
The OIDC authority URL for token validation.
The base URL for the Terminology Service used for validation.
